usage: The word 內衣 (noi6 ji1) is a noun referring to underwear, the clothes worn beneath outer garments.
內衣 is commonly used when talking about buying or wearing undergarments for comfort or hygiene.
You can use 內衣 in both singular and plural contexts according to the context, e.g., 一件內衣 (a piece of underwear).
內衣 is often combined with adjectives describing type or material, like 棉質內衣 (cotton underwear).
In Cantonese sentences, 內衣 can be the subject or object, e.g., 我買咗新內衣 (I bought new underwear).
